title: Toy Imagine Interactive Sound Book for Kids with Marker (Ages 2–7) Learn Alphabets, Numbers, Shapes & Phonics Educational Talking Book with Music & Touch Features Multicolor Learning Toy for Toddlers
bullets: 🎵 Interactive Audio Learning – Engage your child with a dynamic musical book for kids that teaches English letters, words, numbers, shapes, and animal phonetics. Touch-sensitive pages play sounds, making learning fun and immersive.
🔤 Phonetic & Vocabulary Development: Enhance early literacy skills as children explore phonetic concepts, letter recognition, and word formation, fostering a strong language foundation.
🎨 Vibrant & Engaging Design: Colorful illustrations and captivating visuals stimulate visual recognition and creativity, keeping young learners interested and entertained.
🧠 Multi-Sensory Educational Tool: Combines auditory, visual, and tactile learning to promote cognitive development, fine motor skills, and memory retention in a playful manner.

🎁 Perfect Gift for Early Learners – A thoughtful choice in educational toys for 3 year old and up. Ideal for children aged 2 to 7 years, this durable and portable learning book is great for birthdays, holidays, or educational milestones.
🔋 Battery Requirements: 3 AA Batteries (Not Included). Please use 3 × AA non-rechargeable batteries for proper functioning.
